info.name: Get a list of custom sources

params.name: agentPoolId
params.description: Agent pool ID. Mandatory when RBAC is enabled. Ignored when RBAC is disabled.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter custom sources by their names. This filter supports the * wildcard to match multiple values with a common pattern.

params.name: page
params.description: Specifies a zero-based index of the results page to retrieve. The default is 0 (the first page).

params.name: size
params.description: The number of items to include on each page of results. The default is 20.

params.name: sort
params.description: The sorting criteria in the format property (asc|desc), with ascending as the default. Multiple sort parameters can be chained to define primary, secondary, and further sorting levels (e.g., sort=field1,asc&sort=field2,desc). Sortable fields: name.

items.docs:
Get a list of custom sources.

**Required API permission level:** `DEV`
